manifest.name: Custom LLM
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Use your own AI server with Shuffleupagus: any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint, such as LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp or OpenRouter.
manifest.requirement: Needs an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible server, and its API key if it needs one.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: Your endpoint's API key, if it requires one. Leave empty for local servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM) that don't.

api.label: API
api.description: The request dialect your endpoint speaks

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Your server’s root address. For an OpenAI-compatible server, include the version path; for Anthropic, just the host.

model.label: Model
model.description: Model id served by your endpoint

maxTokens.label: Max tokens (optional)
maxTokens.description: The longest reply, in tokens. Anthropic needs one and uses 1024 if it’s empty. Thinking models need room for their reasoning as well as the answer.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning
reasoningEffort.description: How hard a reasoning model (GLM, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1…) thinks. Auto leaves it to the model; Off tries to turn thinking off, which helps when a model spends its whole reply on reasoning. With Anthropic, chat turns that can use tools never think.
